This week’s highlights: Securitize President unpacks Robinhood tokens on Unchained; Carlos Domingo on Milk Road; Best RWA tokenization platforms; Securitize token gains $29.2M; Securitize CEO on shareholder visibility; and Needham analyst backs Securitize’s growth potential. Unchained Podcast Who Gets to Tokenize a Stock Without Asking? Securitize President Brett Redfearn explains what Robinhood’s Jersey-issued AMC stock token carries, whether issuers retain a say after shares begin trading, and how the SEC’s transfer-agent proposal could affect both. WATCH NOW Milk Road Podcast “We’re at the End of the Beginning” - Tokenization Is About to Get Much Bigger Carlos Domingo discusses tokenization’s next phase, covering the risks of offshore “stock tokens,” Securitize’s work with BlackRock and public blockchains, transfer agent modernization, and the infrastructure needed to grow compliant onchain securities into a trillion-dollar market. WATCH NOW Blockchain News Best RWA Tokenization Platforms in 2026: Who Is Winning the $30B+ Market? Named the best overall RWA tokenization platform, Securitize stands out for its scale, vertical integration, and leading asset manager relationships. READ MORE The Cryptonomist Tokenized Stocks Market Hits $3.1B Record as SECZ Leads $29M Surge With $29.2 million added to its onchain market cap, SECZ stands out in a market that barely existed two years ago. READ MORE Real World Asset Summit How Onchain Records Reconnect Companies and Shareholders Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo on why public companies can lose sight of who owns their shares, and how onchain ownership records can make dividends, proxy voting, and shareholder engagement more direct. WATCH NOW TipRanks Securitize initiated with a Buy at Needham Needham analyst John Todaro sees Securitize’s institutional partnerships and infrastructure positioning the company to benefit as RWA tokenization adoption expands. READ MORE

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏛️ Sam Bankman-Fried asks Supreme Court to overturn fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-09-11-sam-bankman-fried-supreme-court-petition-414226?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Sam Bankman-Fried* has filed a petition with the *U.S. Supreme Court* to overturn his fraud conviction and $11 billion forfeiture, seeking a new trial.

* The founder of now-defunct crypto exchange *FTX* is currently serving a 25-year sentence after a jury convicted him on seven counts of fraud, conspiracy, and money laundering for misappropriating customer funds and defrauding investors and lenders.
* His lawyers argued the trial court wrongly prevented him from showing that FTX and *Alameda* , though "temporarily illiquid," held enough assets to eventually repay customers, as they've since been made whole with interest.
* Bankman-Fried also claimed that the order to forfeit $11 billion violates the 8th Amendment's bar on excessive fines.
